title: 第1章 单杀第2章 小红帽
lines: 【ps：以防万一，我估计还是要说一下：本作品中所有的女主均已满18岁】
一片森林，广阔无垠，生机铺展至天边。
树木密集，树干粗壮挺拔，枝叶层层叠叠，交织成一片翠绿的穹顶，遮天蔽日，只留下几缕阳光斑驳地洒落。
格林平静的走在森林里，这是他来到这个世界的第5天了，可是他仍然被困在这个该死的森林里。
他是怎么来到这里的？问的好，可惜格林也不知道答案。
他有着前世的知识，知道自己不是这个世界的人，记得上学时刷题的时光。
但是他就是不记得自己是怎么穿越到这个世界里的，也不记得了有关于自己家人朋友之类的信息，只记得各种各样的知识。
有正常的，也有不正常的。
有正经的，也有不正经的。
[格林]，这是他记得的自己的名字。
不是自己取的，而是记忆中他名字就应该叫这个。
而格林现在还活着，靠的当然……不是他的知识。
而是他的能力——一种不死的能力，每当他死亡的时候，他发觉他的肉体会变成灰烬，而灰烬会在一个火堆旁重组，然后他的意识就回归了。
明明已经死亡了，可他的意识却能感觉到肉体的变化，不知道为什么，感觉有些怪异。
这是他第1天乱吃水果、倒头就睡时发现的。
新的肉体保持着原有的素质，而且还会刷新状态，一些debuff不会被带到之后的身体里。
这是第2天吃蘑菇，躺板板发现的。
哈，重生之后的身体甚至很干净，以至于格林在思考以后是不是不用洗澡了？
重生的地方可以选择，但是一定要有他亲手点燃的火堆，点燃之后的火堆无论发生什么变化都不影响，哪怕火堆被完全扑灭也没事。
这是第3天被狗熊拍死时发现的。
重生的身体没有衣服，也就是说装备不会刷新，只有一件刚穿越过来就披在他身上的黑色斗篷不会消失，每次重生都会伴随着他。
并且他的能力是复活，而不是回溯。
回忆结束，格林突然想起自己这样走来走去的目的，哦，对了，自己要找走出森林的路。
格林继续向东边走着，他从昨天开始就一直走到现在，渴了饿了累了就休息。
实在不行就摆一个小火堆，然后kill刷新一下状态，在确保不会引燃森林火灾后，继续高速移动。
虽然这样轻视自己的生命是不对的，但是格林觉得这既然是自己的能力，那就尽情使用嘛，而且内心感觉这样没什么。
内心毫无波澜地把一个食人花手撕了，格林接着前进，在这个异界中有魔法，也有魔法生物，就如刚刚酷似pvz中大嘴花的植物，格林刚开始还有一些惊慌，但是死的多了，手法也就越发熟练了。
随着时间的推移，已经有些饥饿的格林走到了一个阳光明媚的地方，周围充斥着鸟语花香，整个环境美不胜收……除了那里有个类人型的怪物。
阳光穿透树影，斑驳地洒在那具魁梧身躯上。
它的指节粗大，覆满灰褐色毛发，利爪蜷在掌心未褪，喉间仍残留一声压抑的低吼。
尖利的獠牙从咧开的血盆大口中伸出，每颗牙齿都像是被磨得发亮的钢刀，足以轻松刺穿猎物的皮肉。
狼人那双竖瞳中猩红而贪婪的目光死死锁定着前方，准确来说，锁定着格林，搞得格林一阵恶寒。
“你看你＊呢？”
content_en:
[ps: Just in case, I probably have to say: all the heroines in this work are over 18 years old]
…
A forest, vast and boundless, with vitality spreading to the horizon.
The trees are densely packed, with thick and straight trunks, and layers of branches and leaves, intertwined into a green dome, blocking out the sky and leaving only a few dappled rays of sunlight shining through.
Green walked calmly in the forest. This was his fifth day in this world, but he was still trapped in this damn forest.
How did he get here? It's a good question, but it's a pity that Green doesn't know the answer either.
He has knowledge from his past life and knows that he is not from this world. He remembers the time when he was studying for exams in school.
But he just doesn't remember how he traveled to this world, nor does he remember any information about his family and friends, he only remembers all kinds of knowledge.
There are normal ones and there are abnormal ones.
There are serious ones and there are not serious ones.
[Green], this is the name he remembers.
He didn't choose it by himself, but that's what his name should be in memory.
And Green is still alive now, of course... not because of his knowledge.
It's his ability - an ability to be immortal. Whenever he dies, he finds that his body will turn into ashes, and the ashes will be reorganized next to a fire, and then his consciousness will return.
He was obviously dead, but his consciousness could feel the changes in his body. He didn't know why, but it felt a little strange.
This was what he discovered when he ate fruit randomly and fell asleep on the first day.
The new body maintains its original qualities and will refresh its status, so some debuffs will not be carried over to subsequent bodies.
I found this on the second day after eating mushrooms while lying on the bed.
Ha, the body after rebirth is even very clean, so much so that Green wonders if he won’t need to take a shower in the future?
You can choose the place for rebirth, but there must be a fire lit by him. No matter what changes happen to the fire after it is lit, it will not be affected, even if the fire is completely extinguished.
This was discovered when he was beaten to death by a bear on the third day.
The reborn body has no clothes, which means that the equipment will not be refreshed. Only the black cloak that was draped on him when he crossed over will not disappear and will accompany him every time he is reborn.
And his power is resurrection, not retrospection.
When the memory ended, Green suddenly remembered his purpose of walking around like this. Oh, by the way, he wanted to find a way out of the forest.
Green continued walking eastward. He had been walking since yesterday, resting when he was thirsty, hungry and tired.
If it doesn't work, set up a small fire, then kill to refresh the status. After ensuring that it will not ignite a forest fire, continue moving at high speed.
Although it is wrong to despise one's own life in this way, Green feels that since this is his ability, he should use it to the fullest, and he feels that it is okay in his heart.
Green tore a piranha to pieces without any emotion in his heart, and Green continued to move forward. There was magic in this alien world, and there were also magical creatures, just like the plant that just looked like the big-mouthed flower in PVZ. Green was a little panicked at first, but as he died more, he became more skilled in his techniques.
As time passed, Green, who was already a little hungry, walked to a sunny place, surrounded by birds and flowers, and the whole environment was beautiful...except there was a humanoid monster there.
The sun penetrated the shadows of the trees and sprinkled dappled patterns on the burly body.
Its knuckles were thick and covered with gray-brown hair. Its sharp claws were curled into the palm of its hand, and a suppressed growl still remained in its throat.
Sharp fangs protrude from the gaping mouth. Each tooth is like a polished steel knife, capable of piercing the flesh of prey with ease.
The scarlet and greedy gaze of the werewolf's vertical pupils was fixed in front of him. To be precise, it was locked on Green, causing Green to feel a chill.
"Where do you think you are?"
